decisions.reason: Report distinguishes clipboard-text projection (InputState.draft, Occurrence.offset/length, chips expanded) from detect-text projection (chips = one U+FFFC), quotes host-input-contract.ts and host-input-facade.ts lines directly, and notes plain text/spaces count 1:1.

Locates snapshot.draft.length in plugin add(), traces paste #1 success (empty composer, coordinates coincide) vs paste #2 failure (29 vs detect length 2), explains overshoot of Σ(length−1)=27 per chip, insertReference returning false producing the changed-composer toast, and explicitly rejects stale-revision/race interpretations.

Traces remove(): occurrence.offset/length passed unconverted to consumeToken, false return ignored, records.delete runs anyway; explains live composer chip plus record-undefined rendering as 'unavailable' dock chip, and ties both symptoms to the same coordinate mismatch rather than a separate upload failure.

Derives detect(o)=o−Σ(length−1) over preceding chips, applies it at both call sites (insert at draft end subtracting all preceding occurrences; removal maps offset then uses a one-detect-character span end=start+1), keeps the draftRev guard with re-snapshotting, and gates records.delete on consumeToken returning true / verified success.

Proposes successive pastes (cases 2-3) asserting both chips present, and remove-one-of-several with re-removal (case 6) asserting targeted chip removed while others survive with shifted offsets; adds declined-consumption (case 7), first/last-chip and empty-again variants. Item 5 treated as unscored guidance, consistent with the rubric.
